bugs.description: Export routes lack authentication middleware and body filter validation
bugs.impact: Unauthenticated users can request exports; falls back to 'system' user when no auth
bugs.fix: Add attachActor middleware and validate filters before processing

bugs.description: feeders_per_minute calculation biased by session aggregation
bugs.impact: Operators with high-volume sessions appear faster than they actually are
bugs.fix: Compute feeders_per_minute per-session first, then average across sessions per operator
bugs.notes: Needs second query for per-session rates

bugs.description: OEE components returned in inconsistent units (percentage vs decimal vs raw)
bugs.impact: OEE calculation unreliable; API clients confused about scale
bugs.fix: Normalize all metrics to 0.0-1.0 decimal in service, multiply by 100 only in serialization layer

bugs.impact: Fail-rate calculations meaningless; no BOM context for components
bugs.fix: LEFT JOIN with bom_items table to fetch real BOM usage counts per MPN

bugs.impact: Query only returns 'mismatch' or 'feeder_not_found', never hits fallback
bugs.fix: Use explicit switch statement with logging for unknown alarm types

bugs.impact: Cannot distinguish between feeder vs component failures in error analysis
bugs.fix: Add logic to query and categorize errors by type

bugs.impact: Type safety not enforced; potential runtime errors
bugs.fix: Add proper TypeScript types and interfaces

bugs.description: ReportFilters missing custom date range validation and timezone handling
bugs.impact: User can select invalid date ranges; timezone shifts cause UTC mismatch
bugs.fix: Add startDate > endDate validation; handle timezone properly

bugs.description: Reports page assumes response.report and response.metadata exist without defensive checks
bugs.impact: Crashes if API response structure unexpected
bugs.fix: Add defensive checks and fallback values

bugs.description: ReportDisplay loading spinner missing ARIA attributes
bugs.impact: Screen readers don't announce loading state

bugs.description: Excel export method needs review for similar stream handling issues as PDF
bugs.impact: Excel exports may have memory issues on large files
bugs.fix: Verify all export methods use proper stream piping

bugs.impact: Type inference issues; suggests incomplete types
bugs.fix: Add proper Drizzle type exports and service interfaces

bugs.impact: Type safety issues in request/response handling
bugs.fix: Add proper TypeScript types to route handlers

bugs.description: report_exports table stores raw ip_address and user_agent without anonymization
bugs.fix: Use SHA256 hashing for IP and user-agent; add 90-day purge policy

bugs.description: TODO comment indicating incomplete splice deletion logic
bugs.impact: Splices may not be fully cleaned up when sessions deleted
bugs.fix: Implement CASCADE delete or explicit cleanup
